source_row.extraction_instructions: Events Manager. /sam-events/ shows only 7 featured events; the full list (24 upcoming, mostly FAMUS/FUSIC/PoCUS courses) is on /events/categories/famus/ and /events/categories/other-events/, so the listing unions the three. Listing-card dates are split into spans and wrong; each event page's H1 ('FAMUS Course, 9 October 2026, Wirral') and its 'dd/mm/yyyy @ All Day' line give title and dates. Fees are free text ('Cost: GBP 350', 'Costs / Day 1: ...', 'Fees: ... (NNUH) ... External').

concerns: Cloudflare passive beacon: every real page contains /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/.../jsd/main.js, which http_fetch._CHALLENGE_MARKERS treats as a challenge, so fetch_html returns None for all SAM URLs (even with a browser, it waits 20 s then gives up). Needed base/shared change: match challenge markers only on short bodies or on real interstitial strings (the 'challenge-platform' marker alone is not proof). Worked around in SamExtractor._fetch by reading the browser's own page.

Fees: 22 of 24 events have parsed tiers. The two without are the Bangladesh conference (page only links 'Conference website and registration details' to amcccon.accpfb.com) and the GIRFT national webinar (registration on events.england.nhs.uk); the harness fires PRICE_EXTERNAL_LINK for exactly these two. External sites are not followed by this extractor and organiser_url is not set (the explorer finds the link from the booking page). Level 1 Echocardiography is parsed as early bird 550 until 15 Oct 2026 then 600. No image fee tables, no registration sub-pages and no call-for-papers on any SAM page checked.

The SAM Annual Scientific Meeting (SAMGlasgow, 8-9 Oct 2026) is not in any list on the site any more, so it is not extracted. Two typos in source URLs ('october-206') are handled because the date comes from the 'dd/mm/yyyy' line.

Date precedence: the listing override sets start/end from the event page, so the merge uses them. Titles are the page H1, which embeds date and place; that keeps rows distinct (many FAMUS courses share a name). Prices differ per day/package: tier labels 'Cost . Day 1', 'Cost . Both days', 'Cost . SAM members', 'Cost . NNUH'/'External'.
24 shells need 27 page loads in the listing (3 index pages + 24 event pages) plus 24 detail loads; at 1 s gaps that is about 1 minute. Forced-fallback is moot: the extractor is browser-first.
